segments.text: C.M. Punk Interview- Punk is the best at cutting promos.
Stephanie/Chris Jericho Interview- Stephanie fires Jericho after Jericho couldn't shut his mouth while trying to defy Stephanie.

Vince/Stephanie/Chris Jericho/Randy Orton Interview- Jericho is forced to apologize and gets his job back. Randy Orton comes out to talk more smack and before Vince can fire him, Orton knocks the mic out of Vince's hand and punts him in the head. I thought the interview was lame during the Jericho part as it dragged but again, another intense moment here, this time by Orton and turned this into another great segment. What's going to happen to Orton at the Rumble and next week on Raw? Will I see Vince at the Raw show in Oakland in 3 weeks now?
Randy Orton W/ Legacy & Lawyers/Therapist Interview
Stephanie McMahon + Legacy + Shane McMahon Interview/Brawl.
Shane McMahon + Randy Orton + Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase Jr. Interview
John Bradshaw Layfield + Shawn Michaels Interview.
Randy Orton & Ted DiBiase & Cody Rhodes Interview.
Vickie Guerrero + John Cena + Edge & The Big Show Interview
Legacy + Triple H Interview/Brawl- HHH chases Legacy around the backstage area.
Piper's Pit with Chris Jericho/Superfly Jimmy Snuka- Hosted by Chris Jericho who attacks another legend.
Randy Orton Interview Via Satellite- This happens a few times during the night.
Vickie Guerrero/The Big Show/Edge/John Cena Contract Singing/Interview
Chris Jericho + Ric Flair + Jimmy “Superfly” Snuka + Ricky “The Dragon” Steamboat + Rowdy Roddy Piper Interview.
The Undertaker + Shawn Michaels (on screen) Interview.
Randy Orton + Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase Jr. + Vince McMahon + Shane McMahon + Triple H- Interview/Brawl.
Santino Marella + Beth Phoenix & Rosa Mendes + Melina interview.
The Miz Interview- He calls out John Cena, but he doesn't come out..
Jerry “The King” Lawler + Jillian Hall & Festus Segment.
The Miz Interview/John CEna/Big Show Brawl- Miz calls out Cena, and kinda "shoots" on him, saying some funny stuff..
Miz/Jerry Lawler Interview- Big Show comes out to attack Lawler after Miz did a rap about Cena. I was hoping to see Cena come out and go a little Old School Cena but that wasn't the case.
Vickie Guerrero + Edge Interview- Vickie Quits as Raw GM, and since she is no longer in charge, Edge Says he never loved Vickie and he wants a "divorce"
Randy Orton & Legacy + Triple H Interview/Brawl- HHH returns
Vince/Donold Trump Interview- Turmp "bought" Raw from Vince.
HHH/ORton - HHH attacks Orton as he walks to his car, the show ends.
HHH/ORton - HHH attacks Orton as he walks to his car, the show ends
Mickie James/Miz Interview- They are on Stage, and Maryse Comes out and spryas something in Mickie's Face.
Jerry “The King” Lawler/Shaquille O’Neal/Chris Jericho/The Big Show/Cryme Tyme Interview
Randy Orton/John Cena/Chris Jericho/The Big Show Interview

Triple H/Shawn Michaels Segment- 3 Different videos threw out the night, and HHH goes looking for HBK, in one of the videos HBK sets the grille on fire, in the last video, HBK kicks a child. Funny Stuff.

Vince McMahon + Degeneration X + Legacy (Ted D + Randy Orton Interview/Segment- I thought this Segment was never going to end. IT went about 25 Minutes or so, with No Commercials. DX threw Vince somewhat of a Birthday Bash.
Chris Jericho & The Big Show + Floyd “Money” Mayweather w/Posse + MVP interview
Bob Barker/IRS/Santino/Jillian Hall/Chris Jericho Interview/Segment- They play the Price is "Raw" Game, Santino bids over 1,000 for the Smackdown DVD. Jericho wins with a bid of $1
Bob Barker/IRS/Santino/Jillian Hall/A.J. Peirzenski Interview/Segment- Another Game of Price is "Raw". Santino wins with a bid of $2,000 (it was a WM Travel Package)
Batista/Randy Orton Interview/Segment- Batista is going to Smackdown.
Cedric The Entertainer/Santino Marella/Chavo Guerrero Interview- "Beyonce had the best video of all time"- Cedric

Lilian Garcia Interview- Jerry got on the mic and said tonight was the last night for Lillian. Very, Very emotional for Lillian and everyone else. IT was a hell of 10 years. Im gonna miss Lillian, No one will be able to replace her.
MVP/Mark Henry/Chris Jericho/The Big Show/Rev. Al Sharpton Interview.
Randy Orton/John Cena Interview- Decent Promo, at the next PPV, it will be an Iron Man Match. Neither are Pure Wrestlers. But since there will be NoDQ and Count anywhere, it should be good.
Triple H/Shawn Michaels/Chris Jericho/Big Show Interview
Triple H/Nancy O'Dell/Maria Menounos/Chavo Int/Segment- Maria is fuckin hot, did I tell you that?
Chavo Guerrero & Hornswoggle + Snoop Dogg Segment
Chris Jericho/The Big Show/Joey Lagano/Kyle Bush Interview
Raws Got Talent Segment- Jerry Lawler + Ozzy & Sharon Osbourne + The Great Khali w/Ranjin Singh + Santino Marella + Chris Masters + Chavo Guerrero & Jillian Hall + Jackswoggle.
DX/Hornswoggle/John Cena int- This segment was way to funny
Roddy Piper/Luis Guzman/The Iron Sheik/The Bella Twins Backstage Segment- Good way to start off Raw- " Live From New York, its Monday Night Raw"
The Miz Interview- "Yankees Didn't earn their championship, they bought it"
DX/Hornswoggle Interview- HHH Pedigrees Horny, then DX takes him on on a stretcher.
MSG Video Package- Really Cool Video.
Sheamus Interview- He Attacks the Time Keeper and The King.
Roddy Piper/Randy Orton/Kofi Kingston Interview/Brawl- Kofi and Orton have a nice Brawl threw the Crowd.
Vince McMahon/Shawn Michaels Interview- Bret Hart will Guest Host Next Week!
